backend/main.mo: Implements access-controlled user profiles and product storage with create, fetch, and metadata retrieval operations.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping feature IDs to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten short summaries for numerous frontend files used across the app.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading jsPDF and JSZip CDNs and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing authentication, profile setup, onboarding modal logic, and navigation between editor and export views.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders login/logout button using Internet Identity with query cache clearing and status handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for first-time profile setup allowing users to enter and save their name.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Displays tabbed instructions covering app usage and uploading products to Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Displays generated product bundles with cover previews and buttons to download PDFs, ZIPs, or all products at once.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main app layout with header, footer, authentication display, and optional instructions button.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Shows a modal containing onboarding instructions and export guidance for new users.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Generates a temporary preview URL to display the product PDF or an alert if none exists.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Displays a scrollable preview list of files and folders that will be included in a product ZIP.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Allows editing product fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists, with controls to generate the product.
Manages multiple product editors, auto-saves drafts, and triggers generation for individual or all products.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks to manage Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Manages onboarding modal state, tracking whether instructions were seen and auto‑open logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query wrappers for fetching and saving the caller's user profile through an actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining light/dark theme CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides helpers to resolve and fetch cover blobs.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Utility to trigger browser downloads for Blob and File objects.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date‑based filenames for product PDFs and ZIPs.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Sequentially generates bundles for all products with optional progress callbacks.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a single product bundle by generating its PDF, ZIP, and metadata.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Handles loading, saving, and resetting versioned product drafts in localStorage.
Creates a product PDF using jsPDF with cover, metadata, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Builds a master ZIP containing all product ZIPs and a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Creates a product ZIP including PDF, cover image, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Generates standardized README sections for product usage and marketplace upload instructions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product entries, modules, generation metadata, and generated output bundles including PDF and ZIP blobs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read, store, persist, and clear URL parameters and sessionStorage values, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, color tokens, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, goals, features, and versioning for an app that generates digital product files and export bundles.
